description: This file implements a network change observer that logs network events such as IP address changes, connection type changes, network connections/disconnections, and default network changes. It interacts with the network change notifier and net log system to record these events.

classes.name: LoggingNetworkChangeObserver
classes.description: A class that observes network changes and logs relevant events.

methods.name: HumanReadableNetworkHandle
methods.description: Converts a network handle to a human-readable integer, with special handling for Android Marshmallow.

methods.name: NetworkSpecificNetLogParams
methods.description: Generates a dictionary of network-specific parameters for logging.

methods.name: NetLogNetworkSpecific
methods.description: Logs a specific network event with associated parameters.

methods.name: LoggingNetworkChangeObserver::LoggingNetworkChangeObserver
methods.description: Constructor that registers the observer for various network events.

methods.name: LoggingNetworkChangeObserver::~LoggingNetworkChangeObserver
methods.description: Destructor that unregisters the observer from network events.

methods.name: LoggingNetworkChangeObserver::OnNetworkSoonToDisconnect
methods.description: Handles events when a network is about to disconnect.

methods.name: LoggingNetworkChangeObserver::OnNetworkMadeDefault
methods.description: Handles events when a network is set as default.
